people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.
translations.kjv: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
translations.asv: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest's office unto Jehovah;
